candidate_external_fields.actor: Exact TAG resolved to authenticated live full country handle.
candidate_external_fields.target: Exact TAG resolved to authenticated live full country handle.
candidate_external_fields.casus_belli: Discriminated selection: none, or an available CB definition/instance selected by stable symbolic identity and authenticated current actor/target binding. A free string is not an engine pointer.
candidate_external_fields.war_goal: Typed optional projection selected according to the CB; none is represented internally by the nowargoal singleton. Specific projection can include definition name, province ID, country TAG, region/continent name, subject TAG or rebel identity as required by the specific goal.
candidate_external_fields.attacker: Candidate array of unique exact TAGs; native vector semantics still need a normal selection-site proof.
candidate_external_fields.promised_land: Candidate array of unique exact TAGs; native vector semantics and subset constraints remain unresolved.
candidate_external_fields.full_ally: Candidate array of unique exact TAGs; co-belligerent/UI mapping and membership constraints remain unresolved.

internal_only_fields.stability_0x40: Fix false for ordinary candidate calls. True suppresses native stability cost; never expose as an ordinary diplomacy option.
internal_only_fields.succession_0x41: Special internal path, not an ordinary externally selectable option.
internal_only_fields.colonialwar_0x42: Special internal path, not an ordinary externally selectable option.
internal_only_fields.date: Capture from the held live game generation on the engine thread.
internal_only_fields.envoy_state_value_id: Initialize only through proven native construction and common diplomacy policy.

authenticated available CB and goal definition
exact war goal and both sides
normal caller mapping for all ally vectors
ally response and promised land state
exact war sides and original actors

Normal declaration wrapper/sender caller and all participant selection semantics are closed.
Independent no-send ownership/lifecycle validation succeeds with exact binary and engine-thread context.
